services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Summer Day Camps are an educational opportunity for children in the grades K-6th that run during the summer. Each week of camp is themed and involves fun topics taught through hands-on activities and projects. The days are filled with awesome education and fun that will ignite a desire for more and build memories that last. Click our Camp FAQs below to learn more! Step into a world of towering dinosaurs and explore the life-sized exhibits that bring these giants to life. Explore the principles of taste, texture, and nutrition while discovering the science behind what we eat, how food fuels our bodies, and how it works. services.name: Simply Programs
services.desc: Simply Science and Studies is an educational program that meets once a week for 28 weeks divided among two semesters. This program is for home educated students who are in K-12th grade. Participants can pick individual classes to enroll in or bundle multiple classes on one day for an all-day bundle package. Costs vary depending on your selection of classes and the grade level of the participants. Prices range from $250 for our shortest class to $900 for our all-day Middle and Upper-level S.T.E.A.M. classes. services.name: Craft Night
services.desc: Crafting isn’t just for the kids! We invite guests of all ages* to join us for our quarterly craft nights, where we will create a craft while also learning a science lesson along the way! Discover the art of nature! Join us on Thursday, August 6th from 6:00pm to 8:00pm for a relaxing, hands-on printmaking craft night where you'll gather natural materials and create a one-of-a-kind botanical print. No experience needed. All supplies are provided. Your nature arrangement won't be glued down; instead, we'll photograph your finished design so you can take home a keepsake of your unique creation. services.name: Sailing Camps
services.desc: If you have ever longed to be the master of your own ship, then we have an opportunity for you this summer. In June, Akron Fossils and Science Center will be offering a Learn To Sail class. This class is designed for beginners who would like to learn the basics of sailing. Come join in us as we set sail on a new adventure! The course, which will be taught by AFSC Founder and former Masters National Champion for the Interlake Sailing Class Association, Bill Sanderson, will focus on the rigging of the Sunfish sailboat, a very popular international boat that is raced and used widely as a rental and recreational boat.
